My Morning Routine: 介绍工作日早晨的固定安排。
On workdays, I always get up at six thirty.
column3: 工作日我总是六点半起床。

My Morning Routine: First, I drink a glass of warm water.
Then I run in the park for twenty minutes.
column3: 然后我去公园跑二十分钟步。

My Morning Routine: After running, I take a quick shower.
I usually have bread, eggs and milk for breakfast.
column3: 早餐我通常吃面包、鸡蛋,喝牛奶。

My Morning Routine: While eating, I listen to the news on the radio.
column3: 吃饭时我用收音机听新闻。

My Morning Routine: I leave home at seven forty and walk to the office.
column3: 七点四十出门,步行去公司。

My Morning Routine: This routine keeps me energetic all day.
column3: 这个习惯让我一整天都精力充沛。
